about: Framework vs game boundary (#739, tracker #747; charter -> 'Framework vs game'). Read by tests/architecture/framework-game-boundary.test.js. apiSurface is every framework module game code imports: exactly what the split must publish (#742). An entry with `seam` is game content still living in the framework, relocated by that issue. pathSeams are framework source that names a game path (process or URL boundaries, not imports); each carries the issue that removes it. skinConsumers are the framework files allowed to import the skin module contracts/game-elements.js (#740); everything else imports the vocabulary from contracts/game-vocabulary.js. A path inside both a framework and a game root is game: the reference terminal client (`packages/ui-ascii`, kept by Darren 2026-11-06, #741) is framework, its phone-app files are game until they move (#744). Every list is exact: unused entries fail.
